note: Decisions that need Abdullah's eye — each item shows the evidence, the proposed action, and the alternatives. items.title: The stroke at x=15 that no budget wants
items.evidence: A fatha-sized stroke (6.9x3.6u) sits over وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ's ة beside its two-dots, at the same height. Every word's slash budget on lines 6-7 is satisfied without it; it currently sits (wrongly) in لَا's count, 300u away.
items.proposal: Reassign to وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ as LETTER ink (part of the ة region), i.e. it is not a diacritic at all.
alternatives: it IS a mark of وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ (which one?)
it belongs to مُشْرِكَةًۭ's tanween pair

items.title: Two م-shaped glyphs at the جُدَدٌۢ/بِيضٌۭ boundary
items.evidence: Two small م glyphs sit side by side: x304-309 (claimed by جُدَدٌۢ as its iqlab meem) and x301-305 (left in بِيضٌۭ as a surplus letter piece). بِيضٌۭ's iqlab is the low ۭ form, which usually draws no separate glyph.
items.proposal: The x301-305 glyph is بِيضٌۭ's own iqlab م drawn high (the ۭ DOES leave a glyph here): convert it to بِيضٌۭ's meem-iqlab mark.
alternatives: it is جُدَدٌۢ's م and جُدَدٌۢ claimed the wrong one
it is letter ink of بِيضٌۭ's ب

items.title: أَهْوَآءَهُم label confusion (your '3 fathas, 1 sukun' note)
items.evidence: After the بَعْدَ مَا line is repaired, this word's own marks need re-naming: the audit counted 5 fathas + 2 sukuns + 1 dot; your eye counted 3 fathas + 1 sukun and no dot. The extras are بعد's marks; what remains may still carry wrong names.
items.proposal: Defer until the line fix lands, then re-audit; if names still disagree with your count, label the specific blobs on a label sheet.

items.title: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ 'missing fatha at the end' — print fact or pipeline loss?
items.evidence: Your note says the final fatha is missing. If the INK truly lacks it, that is a fact about the 1421H print (like إِلْ يَاسِينَ's extra piece) and becomes a recorded exception; if the stroke exists nearby, some word stole it.
items.proposal: You look at the printed page: is there a fatha drawn at the word's end anywhere? If absent → record as print-fact exception. If present → tell me which word holds it.

items.title: Sajdah-line policy (also p589 يَسْجُدُونَ ۩)
items.evidence: Your shape-note: the sajdah overline should group with the word below it. Currently it is classified ad hoc; p272 ظِلَـٰلُهُۥ has the sajdah line beneath it interfering with its ink.
items.proposal: Adopt the policy: the sajdah overline is a STANDALONE sign attached to the sajdah word's group (like hizb/rub signs), never counted as a mark or letter of any word. Applied mushaf-wide (15 sajdah sites).
alternatives: attach as a non-counting mark of the word below

items.title: Body steal: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ / نَارًۭا
items.evidence: Your verdicts: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ is missing a large part of تكم; نَارًۭا stole a large part from the word before it. A letter-ink move between the two would fix both.
items.proposal: Move the surplus body piece(s) of نَارًۭا back to فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ, guarded by the joining-rule piece budgets of both words (deficit == surplus, pieces adjacent).
alternatives: geometry override from the review platform instead of a pass

items.title: Body steal: مَا swallowed by يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ (3:75:8)
items.evidence: Your verdict: bodyless مَا; 3:75:8 holds it. Same shape as P6.
items.proposal: Same mechanism as P6: piece-budget-guarded return of the مَا ink.

items.title: Body steal: بَارِدٍۢ swallowed لَّا with its diacritics
items.evidence: Your verdict: بَارِدٍۢ holds the previous word لَّا entirely (its shadda surplus is لَّا's). لَّا (56:44:1) shows shadda 0/1.
items.proposal: Same mechanism as P6: return لَّا's body + its marks together, guarded by both words' budgets.

items.title: PRE-APPROVED: the p341 chain (اجتمعوا ← له ← وإن, + منه's ۥ)
items.evidence: Abdullah's screenshots: اجتمعوا holds [اجتمعوا + له + ۖ + damma]; له holds only the و of وإن; وإن lacks its و; منه (22:73:25) holds له's small waw. One chained repair returns each piece one step right.
items.proposal: Execute the chain: له's body+pause+damma back from اجتمعوا; the و back from له to وإن; the ۥ back from منه to له. Guarded by each word's piece and mark budgets.

P1.note: one belongs to مُشْرِكَةًۭ's tanween at top, the other is kasrah under مشركة ر
P1.resolution: SCOPE EXPANDED by Abdullah's color-coded rendering of p350 line 6: the mark ownership is rotated across the whole tail (إلا زانيةً أو مشركةً والزانية) — marks of each word sitting over the neighbour's letters. Not a two-stroke override: this is the LINE-SET repair (re-own all marks of a line against all budgets simultaneously, minimum total displacement), same mechanism the xband agent recommended for the refused chains (p267, p371, p535, p599 chain from P4). p350 line 6 is the canonical test case.

P2.resolution: x301-305 = جدد's iqlab م (mark); x304-309 = جدد's second د (letter body)
